name: Misakura Rin
source:
Rin is protagonist's childhood friend, and is quite clumsy. She moved to the countryside, but then moved back, transferring to Naoya's class. She refers to Naoya as "Kusanagi-kun", but used to call him "Nao-kun" before she moved back.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakura_no_Uta]Wikipedia[/url]]
